question: Which of the following wildlife sanctuaries is located in Goa?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary** is present in **Goa.**
 
• Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary is situated in** Mollem town**.
 
• Currently there are six wildlife sanctuaries in Goa.</stro
